description: Registrar General's Department - The List of Notaries in Sri Lanka up to 31.12.2015
categorisation: This gazette contains a list of notaries public, including their names, judicial divisions, office addresses, dates of appointment, and languages of practice. This falls under judicial administration and the appointment of officers authorized to perform legal functions (notarization), which aligns with Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes) for court and judicial officer appointments and matters.
